title.narrative: Digital Republic of the Marshall Islands Project

description.narrative: The Project will support investments to increase access to digital services. The Project will also support Government's efforts to move towards an integrated Digital Government Platform that will help to provide greater efficiency and resource-sharing within Government, facilitate better communication with citizens and residents, and introduce a more service-oriented approach to serving individuals and business users. Technical assistance will also be provided on legal, regulatory and policy related issues to build trust around the use of digital services.

To expand access to the internet, promote efficient investment in climate resilient digital infrastructure, establish a secure Government network, and the critical foundations for digital government services and the digital economy in the Recipient's territory

condition.narrative: Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.A.1. The Recipient shall provide oversight, coordination, and support for Projectimplementation through the Project Steering Committee in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement and the ProjectOperations Manual.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.A.2. The Recipient shall maintain, during the entire period of the Projectimplementation, the Project Steering Committee, chaired by a Minister, and comprised of, inter alia, senior level representativesfrom the relevant ministries and other stakeholders, all as appointed by the Recipient's cabinet and set forth in the ProjectOperations Manual, and with an institutional framework, functions, and resources required for the implementation of the Project, inform and substance satisfactory to the Association.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.A.3. The Recipient shall maintain, during the entire period of the Projectimplementation, the Project Implementation Unit within the Ministry of Finance, Banking and Postal Services, and upon the executionof the PPP Contract or the achievement of other milestone(s) agreed by the Recipient and the Association and set forth in theProject Operations Manual, within the Ministry of Transportation, Communications and Information Technology, with a mandate,composition and resources satisfactory to the Association, which shall be responsible for, inter alia, carrying out day-to-daymanagement of the Project and coordinating overall Project implementation, all in accordance with the details set forth in theProject Operations Manual.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.A.4. The Recipient shall maintain, during the entire period of the Projectimplementation, the Central Implementation Unit within the Ministry of Finance, Banking and Postal Services, with a mandate,composition and resources satisfactory to the Association, which shall be responsible for providing support on fiduciary aspects ofProject management and implementation, including, inter alia, procurement, financial management, audit, monitoring and evaluation,and environmental and social risk management.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.A.5. The Recipient shall maintain, during the entire period of the Projectimplementation, a Project focal point within the Office of the Attorney-General, with terms of reference, qualifications andexperience satisfactory to the Association, who shall be responsible for supporting the Ministry of Finance, Banking and PostalServices with the implementation of Part 1 of the Project and the Ministry of Transportation, Communications and InformationTechnology with the implementation of Part 3.2 of the Project.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.B.1. The Recipient shall ensure that the purchase of shares in the form of a buy-out ofminority private shareholders of NTA is carried out in accordance with the valuation methodology, offer structure and details setforth in the Project Operations Manual.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.B.2. The Recipient shall engage, prior to the execution of the PPP Contract by theparties thereto, and thereafter maintain such role, during the entire period of the PPP Contract, a firm or an individual to serveas a contract administration agent, with terms of reference, qualifications and experience satisfactory to the Association, whichshall be responsible for, inter alia, supporting the Recipient on its administration and monitoring of the execution of the PPPtransaction in accordance with the details set forth in the Project Operations Manual.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.B.3. The Recipient shall, under PPP arrangements, enter into a legally bindingcontractual arrangement with a private partner, selected on a competitive basis in accordance with the criteria and requirementsset forth in the Project Operations Manual and the Procurement Regulations, for the rollout and delivery of high-quality, low-costdigital infrastructure and services under Part 1.3 of the Project, in form and substance satisfactory to the Association and inaccordance with the details set forth in the Project Operations Manual (referred to herein for east of reference only as the "PPPContract"). Without limitation to the generality of the foregoing, the PPP Contract shall, inter alia: (a) reflect theinstitutional and governance arrangements and performance obligations of the parties in accordance with the details set forth inthe Project Operations Manual, including to require the private partner to commit to invest its own funds to meet any additionalcapital expenses, working capital and operational expenses as necessary to meet its commitments under the PPP Contract; (b) requirethe private partner to maintain accounting system and keep records of expenditures to reflect the payment and performancemilestones and mechanism in accordance with the details set forth in the Project Operations Manual; and (c) contain provisionssatisfactory to the Association for the purpose of requiring the private partner to comply with the provisions of theAnti-Corruption Guidelines and the relevant aspects of the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan ("ESCP") and the environmentaland social instruments referred to therein.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.B.6. The Recipient shall wholly own, from the end of the PPP Contract, and thereaftermaintain, during the entire period of the Project implementation, a state-owned entity, with a mandate, composition and resourcessatisfactory to the Association (such entity shall be referred to herein for ease of reference only as “InfraCo”), for the purposesof providing, on a not-for-profit and wholesale only basis, cost-based and non-discriminatory access to international and domesticfiber optic infrastructure and other facilities to provider(s) who wish(es) to provide telecommunication services to end users inthe Recipient's territory.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.B.7. The Recipient shall establish, prior to the end of the PPP Contract, and thereaftermaintain, during the entire period of the Project implementation, a telecommunications regulator position, with a mandate,composition and resources satisfactory to the Association, which shall be responsible for, inter alia, undertaking statutoryresponsibilities for licensing, market and technical regulation, customer protection, monitoring and enforcement.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.C.1. The Recipient shall ensure that the collection, use and processing (includingtransfers to third parties) of any Personal Data collected under the Project shall be done in accordance with the bestinternational practice, ensuring legitimate, appropriate, and proportionate treatment of such data, and in accordance with thedetails set forth in the Project Operations Manual.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.D The Recipient shall adopt, not later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, andthereafter maintain, during the entire period of the Project implementation, the Project Operations Manual, satisfactory to theAssociation, which shall set forth, inter alia, the detailed arrangements and procedures for the implementation of the Project. TheRecipient shall ensure that the Project is carried out in accordance with the Project Operations Manual, and except as theAssociation may otherwise agree in writing, the Recipient shall not amend or waive, or permit to be amended or waived, anyprovision of the Project Operations Manual. In the event of any conflict between the provisions of the Project Operations Manualand those of this Agreement, the provisions of this Agreement shall prevail.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I.E. The Recipient shall prepare and furnish to the Association not later than: (a) twomonths after the Effective Date (or such later date as the Association may agree); and (b) July 1 of each year for every subsequentyear during the implementation of the Project (or such later date as the Association may agree) for the Association's review andno-objection, an annual work plan and budget. The Recipient shall ensure that the Project is implemented in accordance with theAnnual Work Plans and Budgets, provided, however, that in the event of any conflict between the Annual Work Plans and Budgets andthe provisions of this agreement, the provisions of this agreement shall prevail. Any amendment to an Annual Work Plan and Budgetneeded during the fiscal year covered by such plan shall be subject to the prior written no-objection of the Association.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section II.2. The Recipient shall: (a) not later than four (4) years after the Effective Date (orsuch other date as the Association may agree in writing), prepare and furnish to the Association a mid-term report, in such detailas the Association shall reasonably request; documenting progress achieved in the carrying out of the Project during the periodpreceding the date of such reports, taking into account the monitoring and evaluation activities performed pursuant to Section II.1and setting out the measures recommended to ensure the continued efficient carrying out of the Project and the achievement of itsobjectives during the period following such date; and and (b) review with the Association such mid-term report, on or about thedate one (1) month after its submission, carry out a mid-term review of the Project, and thereafter take all measures required toensure the continued efficient implementation of the Project and the achievement of its objectives, based on the conclusions andrecommendations of the mid-term report and the Association's views on the matter.
